fleetAudit.whyNoCountersMoved: S1 changes only future runner policy. It rendered no family and wrote no overlay; R8 and later repair lanes own the rerenders that can change committed artifact counters.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: Agency fields are never prefilled by this build.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: The exact AZ participant-stated agency blank maps to matter.citing_or_arresting_agency for both AZ variants.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: Prosecutor and agency fields are never prefilled by this build.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: no exact prosecuting-agency fact is held; surface this blank to the participant and do not guess.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: No allowlisted, source-supported fact is offered to this terminal field.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: Exact CA terminal-name mappings write held facts; remaining unheld fields are classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and must be surfaced rather than guessed.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: No allowlisted fact is offered to this blank.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with an explicit no-guess and participant-surfacing requirement.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: Signature or date field; never prefilled.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: Only an actual signature or signature-date stays participant-owned; an unheld matter date is REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and surfaced without guessing.

rows.unheldFactsTreatment: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING; no invented offense subparts, prosecutor identity, alternate identity, local-court address, narrative, signature, service act, or unmade election.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: An exact document-id plus terminal-name mapping when the fact is held; otherwise required_before_filing.

refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.previous: No write is authorized for this field in this family build.
refusalReasonsRemovedOrReplaced.replacement: A bounded fact write, a named protected/later-act treatment, or REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with participant surfacing; no build-policy-only refusal remains.
signature_or_sworn_participant_act for actual signing/sworn acts; all other unheld dates are required_before_filing and surfaced.

rows.exactFallback: If the generic semantic binder rejects an exact allowlisted text field because of a source naming conflict, the runner writes the held fact into every exact measured widget, enforces readable fit, records the write, and scans the output for active content. Duplicate-widget losers remain refused.
rows.unheldFactsTreatment: required_before_filing; generated participant instructions enumerate every such source field and tell the participant to supply and verify it before filing.
